Dependency carry-over (DP rows above): the H and C dependencies these DP rows add are build-against dependencies tracked in this section and form part of the dependency map. None blocks the start: H platform rows are checked at pickup and C rows are built against their published contract and fake. Ready to start stays Day 1 and the metadata rows stay as the Work Package fixes them. A secondary slice builds against the platform contracts and published fakes and reads same-service wave-1 rows through its own schema. CloudEvents binary-mode headers ce_id, ce_type, ce_source and ce_subject are carried in the event envelope; ce_id is the event identity and ce_type follows rwb.<short>.<Event>.v1. The value form of ce_source and ce_subject is agreed in this naming library and applied uniformly in every producer; it is Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0130) until agreed.
